description:
Update a space property by its id. 

**[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**:
Permission to access the Confluence site ('Can use' global permission) and 'Admin' permission for the space.

parameters.name: space-id
parameters.description: The ID of the space the property belongs to.

parameters.name: property-id
parameters.description: The ID of the property to be updated.

requestBody.description: The space property to be updated.

200.description: Returned if the space property was updated successfully.

schema.description: Returns the URL at which the space property is retrievable.

400.description: Returned if an invalid request is provided.

401.description:
Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing
from the request.

404.description:
Returned if the calling user does not have permission to view the
specified space or the space was not found.
